rationale: Cd34 marks an MSC-like fibroblast population in the mouse mesenchymal taxonomy.
Cd44 is reported as a mouse MSC-associated stromal marker.
CXCL12 is expressed by prospectively characterized mouse mesenchymal progenitors.
Endoglin is observed in mouse bone-marrow stromal populations but has tissue-dependent expression.
CD51 is used with Sca-1 to enrich mouse mesenchymal progenitors.
Lepr labels an adult mouse skeletal stromal stem and progenitor compartment.
Sca-1 is part of the prospectively validated murine mesenchymal progenitor phenotype.
Nt5e is reported in a defined mouse mesenchymal progenitor compartment.
PDGFRalpha is part of the prospectively validated murine mesenchymal progenitor phenotype.
Prrx1 lineage tracing identifies a mouse mesenchymal progenitor compartment.
Thy1 is reported as a mouse MSC-associated stromal marker.
VCAM1 is a commonly reported MSC surface marker but lacks sufficiently tissue-matched mouse support for this v1 core.
exclusion_reason: Insufficient mouse limb-MSC specificity for the frozen v1 core
